adjudication.rationale: The findMembers function at line 31 makes an async AJAX call and then sets properties including offset and members in the callback. If a user rapidly clicks pagination (next/previous), multiple requests can be in flight simultaneously. Since there's no request cancellation or sequencing, an older response arriving after a newer one would overwrite the current state with stale data (wrong offset and members). The diff shows the pagination actions (next/previous) call findMembers() without any mechanism to handle race conditions between concurrent requests.
